posts.name: Google DeepMind
posts.text:
Your heart, brain, and immune system share the same DNA sequence. So how can a single-letter change affect disease in some cells, while sparing the rest?

AlphaGenome 2 is our new AI model that zooms in on specific cells to help scientists understand what drives disease.

posts.author: GoogleDeepMind
posts.name: Google DeepMind
posts.text:
Looking at a whole tissue at once is like looking at a blurry image: you get the visuals, but miss what’s happening inside individual pixels.

Trained on 100M+ profiles across 68 tissues, AlphaGenome 2 focuses on one cell type at a time, spotting nearly twice as many mutations

For the first time, AI has mathematically proven 
@signalapp
’s protocol is secure down to the code level.

Using our breakthrough AlphaProof Code framework, we verified the messaging app’s cryptographic system – which protects billions of private messages every day.

posts.author: GoogleDeepMind
posts.name: Google DeepMind
posts.text:
Gemini agents generated over 6M lines of proofs in Lean, auditing the code so human experts only had to review the critical 1%.

This is a key step toward using AI to verify vital infrastructure we all rely on – from daily communication to power grids. Find out more →
